display.purpose: Defined at 3rem (42 px rendered) but not used on everyday screens.

headline.purpose: Page titles, 1.5rem (21 px rendered), semibold: the largest text on most screens.

body.purpose: All running text and controls: 0.875rem = 14 px (root font size is 16 px).

mono.purpose: Verdicts, times, counters, the wordmark: 0.75rem, 10.5 px rendered.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, drawers and popovers (dark); 0 8px 24px rgb(15 17 20 / 0.12) in light.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Colour transitions on controls; the fill of a test cell.

motion.name: flash
motion.value: accent at 45% fading to transparent over 1.4s

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action of a view: ink on paper.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line field with a label above.

components.name: Verdict Badge
components.description: Monospace verdict label; never colour alone.

narrative.overview: Match Day (2026-10-10, UI-14): type does the work, colour means state, and the screens people watch together are big. Neutral surfaces, ink-on-paper primary action, blue identity colour, flat with hairlines, no gradients; Stage and Workbench densities share one system.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first with full light parity, contrast checked in tests
Ink on paper for the one primary action; blue for identity only
Flat: tone and hairlines, one overlay shadow, no gradients
16 px root; body 14, floor 12, h1 28, display 40 to 72

rules.name: The Tokens-Only Rule
rules.body: Raw colours live in tokens.css and the Monaco theme only.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: A verdict is never colour alone.

rules.name: The One Filled Button Rule
rules.body: A view or row has one ink-filled action; blue is identity, never a button beside it.

rules.name: The Twelve Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing renders below 12 px; SVG labels are on the scale too.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadow at rest; only overlays float. No gradients or glows.

dos: Do keep a text label on every verdict
Do keep keyboard access and the visible focus ring
Do give each view one ink-filled action
Do say a number in words next to its display numeral
Do keep long handles and titles inside the page (wrap, truncate, or scroll in a labelled box)
donts: Don't use hard-coded hex outside token files
Don't convey meaning by colour alone
Don't fill with blue or put a blue button beside an ink one
Don't use a size below 12 px
